payload.description: What the wind-up of the council's housing company finally cost. Lion Homes (Norwich) Ltd went into a solvent liquidation in 2025. The accounts record £6.15m of loans written down to nil and the shareholding written down from £3.424m to £2.825m, and the council says creditors will be paid in full and it keeps the company's assets. The auditor reported that "Based on the evidence available, there is no indication that adequate oversight arrangements for subsidiaries have ever existed". No published document gives a final cost, and we will not publish an estimate of one.
